Script.name: MedBootstrap
Script.script:
local meduiPackage = "MedUI"
-- function to install or update your MUD package local function installServerPackage() local installedVersion = mpkg.getInstalledVersion(meduiPackage) local repoVersion = mpkg.getRepositoryVersion(meduiPackage)
if not installedVersion then mpkg.install(meduiPackage) return end
if semver(installedVersion) < semver(repoVersion) then mpkg.upgrade(meduiPackage) end end
-- mpkg.install() gives up without retrying while the package listing is still -- downloading. Not mpkg.ready(): that starts another download each time it is false local function installWhenMpkgReady(triesLeft) if mpkg and mpkg.packages and mpkg.packages.packages then installServerPackage() elseif triesLeft > 0 then tempTimer(5, function() -- the timer outlives an uninstall of this package if table.contains(getPackages(), "MedBootstrap") then installWhenMpkgReady(triesLeft - 1) end end) else cecho("\n<orange>MedBootstrap: the package listing did not arrive, so MedUI is not installed yet. It will be tried again the next time this profile is opened.<reset>\n") end end
-- install mpkg if not already local mpkgVersion = getPackageInfo("mpkg", "version")
if mpkgVersion == "" then installPackage("https://github.com/Mudlet/mudlet-package-repository/raw/refs/heads/main/packages/mpkg.mpackage") end
installWhenMpkgReady(12)
